questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Kidney

2. Heart

3. Brain

4. Thyroid gland

5. Liver
questions.solution:
These organs are to be arranged on the basis of position of organs in the body from top to bottom.

So, correct arrangement will be Brain > Thyroid gland > Heart > Liver > Kidney.

Hence, the correct order will be 3, 4, 2, 5, and 1.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All squirrels are lizards.

All lizards are goose.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some squirrels are not goose.

II. Some lizards are squirrels.

III. Some goose are squirrels.

options.text: Conclusions I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
**Statement I:** All squirrels are lizards.

**Statement II:** All lizards are goose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d265016ef51a14e83f4d77f6e63f27f48ca568870cd9fddda9be27eb89a5badb.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I: Some squirrels are not goose → False.

II: Some lizards are squirrels → True.

III: Some goose are squirrels → True.

Hence, “Conclusion II and III” follows.

questions.question:
Select the number that will replace “?” in the following series.

120, 128, 144, 168, ?, 240

Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

16 : 240 ∷ 6 : ?
questions.solution:
Logic follow here is,

In case of 16 : 240,

16 : ((16)² – 16) → 16 : (256 – 16)

= 16 : 240;

Similarly,

6 : ((6)² – 6) → 6 : (36 – 6)

= **6 : 30**

Hence, “30” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Which symbol is on the face opposite the face showing ‘*’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7a3ab82841ca2b8602926c1bdee96d1dca516b7d4cd7ca73bb101370494eca1.png]
questions.solution:
The symbol # appears in 2 dice position i.e. 1st and 2ⁿd from which it is evident that $, &, + and * are adjacent to it and cannot be opposite to #. From this we can conclude that # will face opposite to %.

Similarly, + appears in 2 dice positions i.e. 2ⁿd and 3rd from which it is evident that #, *, &, % are adjacent to it and cannot be opposite to +. So, + will face opposite to $.

From the above conclusions we can conclude that * and & will face each other.

Hence, “&” is the correct answer.

questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Natasha and Krishna is 50 years. 10 years ago, Krishna was twice as old as Natasha. What is Krishna’s current age?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Natasha be” x” and age of Krishna be “y”.

As per statement given in question:

x + y = 50 ...(i) and

Ten years ago:

Natasha = x -10 years old

Krishna = y -10 years old

→ y – 10 = 2(x – 10)

→ 2x –y = 20 – 10 ...(ii)

From both the equations (i) and (ii)

→ 2x + 2y = 100

→ 2x – y = 10

→ 3y = 90 → y = 30

And x = 20.

Hence, Krishna’s age is 30 years.

questions.question:
A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A - B means ‘A is the father of B’

A × B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

If P + R × T – Q ÷ S + U, then how is S related to T?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4734124aa3b7d396a7a08fbc3e79608a4ec76a796de93f0cf95a52ee4783c702.png] 

According to the question, P + R × T – Q ÷ S + U can be decoded as P is mother of R, R is sister of T, T is father of Q, Q is daughter of S, S is mother of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfaec976db634f8c2aa3d204bcf1d83a55e65b857a7c627ee9e1311c3e1456f7.png] 

From the above arrangement, S is wife of T.

Hence, “Wife” is the correct answer.
